svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: brwr-trmnl v1 wiring, back view
svg.desc: Where each module sits and how the cables run, seen from the back with the back cover off: carrier, driver HAT, battery, panel flex and adapter, button board, antenna and magnets.
svg.text: brwr-trmnl v1 — wiring, seen from the back
Back cover off, looking at the back of the panel: left and right are swapped compared with the front. The HAT is on the right here
and on the left seen from the front. Dashed outlines are parts on the far side of a board, facing the panel. Positions from the enclosure model.
panel flex, folded behind the panel
Check polarity with a meter first.
tied up the back cover at X = −30
Front-view X is mirrored here: the charger
(X = +22) is left of the XIAO (X = −8), and the
MiniBoost (X = −28) is at the carrier's right end.
The carrier and HAT face the panel. Their plugs
sit between board and panel; route the cables
around the board edges as drawn.
Magnets stay ≥ 25 mm from any board edge
